findings.evidence: `Parameters.lean:8` imports only `Physlib.Particles.StandardModel.Basic`; `Parameters.lean:281-286` already documents the PDG formula these definitions implement and `Parameters.lean:289-292` enters it as data. `ElectricCharge.lean:8-12` and `Representation.lean:8` are the heavy imports `Couplings.lean:8-10` adds. A symptom of the split level is that `Couplings.lean` has to close `namespace FermionNeutralCurrentCouplings` and reopen it later so `ofQuantumNumbers_neutrino` can use the intervening Standard Model charge lemmas.
findings.fix: Move those eleven declarations into `Parameters.lean`, into the existing "Tree-level couplings and weak charges" section beside `smTreeLevelCouplings` (whose docstring at line 282 already states `g_V^f = T_3^f - 2 Q_f sin^2(theta_W)`, `g_A^f = T_3^f`). Keep in `Couplings.lean` only what genuinely needs the quantum numbers: the `doubletElectricCharge_standardModel_*` / `singletElectricCharge_standardModel_*` lemmas, `smTreeLevelCouplings_eq_ofQuantumNumbers` and `ofQuantumNumbers_neutrino`.
findings.issue: `chiralCoupling`, `chiralCoupling_def`, `chiralCoupling_zero_left`, `chiralCoupling_charge_zero`, `FermionNeutralCurrentCouplings.ofQuantumNumbers`, `ofQuantumNumbers_gV`, `_gA`, `_gL`, `_gR`, `eq_ofQuantumNumbers_iff` and `ofQuantumNumbers_neutral` take only real arguments and use only `Parameters.lean` (`FermionNeutralCurrentCouplings`, `gL_def`, `gR_def`, `ext_gL_gR_iff`). Placing them in a file that imports `Electroweak.ElectricCharge` and `Electroweak.Representation` makes every downstream user of the general coupling function pull in `Mathematics.LieAlgebra.SpecialUnitary.Extensions`, `Particles.StandardModel.HiggsBoson.BasicExtensions`, `QFT.QCD.SU2Generators`, `Physlib.Relativity.PauliMatrices.Basic` and `Physlib...AnomalyCancellation.Basic`, none of which they need; it also makes the canonical follow-up the PR description names (redefining `smTreeLevelCouplings` through `ofQuantumNumbers`) impossible, since `Parameters.lean` cannot import `Couplings.lean`.

summary: Placement in Electroweak/ and all three imports are right, but the general coupling API (chiralCoupling, FermionNeutralCurrentCouplings.ofQuantumNumbers and their algebraic lemmas) depends on nothing past Parameters.lean and belongs there, next to smTreeLevelCouplings and the PDG convention block it formalises.
